description: Recompute a FidelityCopy/FidelityPass verdict from source and output bytes, or return N/A when no exact 1:1 copy is in scope. Missing bytes, stale metadata, or prose-only AI proof cannot PASS.

copy_scope.description: Explicit FidelityPass scope. Use not_applicable to record the XPass N/A row when no exact copy is in scope.

copyroom_source_packet.description: CopyRoom source packet used as the source of truth. Mutually exclusive with source_text/source_base64.

encoding.description: CopyRoom v1 encoding. Defaults to utf8.

newline_policy.description: CopyRoom v1 newline policy. Defaults to preserve.

exact_copy_required.description: Set false only when the target has no exact 1:1 copy, transcription, mirroring, or preservation scope. Returns N/A.

mode.description: Verification mode. Defaults to raw_bytes or the provided receipt mode.

output_base64.description: Exact output bytes as base64. Mutually exclusive with output_text.

output_ref.description: Output pointer used in the recomputed receipt.

output_text.description: Exact output text to verify. Mutually exclusive with output_base64.

proof_text.description: Optional prose proof. Prose alone is suppressed, not accepted as PASS.

provenance_ref.description: Optional Boardroom, issue, PR, or CopyRoom pointer for audit trail.

receipt.description: Optional previous FidelityCopy receipt to compare against recomputed hashes.

scope_reason.description: Reason why FidelityPass is N/A for this target. Used only when exact_copy_required=false or copy_scope=not_applicable.

source_base64.description: Exact source bytes as base64. Mutually exclusive with source_text.

source_ref.description: Source pointer used in the recomputed receipt.

source_text.description: Exact source text to verify. Mutually exclusive with source_base64.

name: fidelitypass_verify_copy
